The iCoke Event was a marketing campaign held in mainland China during 2005 and 2006 and in Taiwan during 2006. In China, operated jointly by The9 (the Chinese WoW operator at the time), Blizzard Entertainment, and Coca‑Cola China, the events distributed physical merchandise, game time, and exclusive in‑game pets through codes found on promotional Coca‑Cola products. These campaigns represent the earliest large‑scale commercial cross‑promotions for World of Warcraft in China and Taiwan and are notable for distributing some region‑exclusive pets. Pop group were national brand ambassadors during the promotion. Their imagery appeared on iCoke.cn, in TV commercials, and in retail displays during
